test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The simple interest on a certain deposit at 5.5% per annum is ₹264 in one year. How much additional interest will be earned in one year on the same deposit at 6.5% per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

The simple interest on a certain deposit at 5.5% per annum is ₹264 in one year.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Where,

P = Principal

R = Rate of interest

T = Time (in years)
